hooks.command:
in=$(cat)
field() { printf '%s' "$in" | grep -oE "\"$1\" *: *\"[^\"]*\"" | head -n 1 | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]*)"$/\1/'; }
if [ "$(field tool_name)" = SendMessage ]; then
  tp=$(field transcript_path)
  role=$(grep -oE '"agentType" *: *"[^"]*"' "${tp%.jsonl}/subagents/agent-$(field to).meta.json" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]*)"$/\1/')
  what='resume'
else
  role=$(field subagent_type)
  what='run'
fi
case "$role" in architect|planner|coder|judge|hardener) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0
dir=''
for d in $( { printf '%s' "$in" | grep -oE '\.cairn/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/'; printf '%s' "$in" | grep -oE 'EPIC-[0-9]+' | sed 's#.*#.cairn/&/#'; } | sort -u); do
  if ls "$d"epic.*.md >/dev/null 2>&1; then dir=$d; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$dir" ]; then echo "Cairn: this $role $what names no epic whose folder .cairn/<id>/ holds an epic file. Give the epic and the unit's file in the prompt or the message, as the session skill says." >&2; exit 2; fi
n=$(grep -rhcE '^## .* · (architect|planner|coder|judge|hardener) · ' "$dir" | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}')
go=$(grep -hoE "^Pilot's go: .*role entries, at [0-9]+" "$dir"epic.*.md | grep -oE '[0-9]+$' | sort -n | tail -n 1)
next=$(( (${go:-0} / 120 + 1) * 120 ))
if [ "$n" -lt "$next" ]; then exit 0; fi
echo "Cairn: the epic $dir counts $n role entries, and no Pilot's go covers the bound at $next. Launch or resume nothing on the epic: tell the pilot what was spent and what still fails, and land their go in the epic file as CHECKS.md says, its first line reading: Pilot's go: 120 role entries, at $(( n / 120 * 120 ))" >&2
exit 2
